{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
total_rows = len(df)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]

print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA orders: {qa_orders["order_id"].tolist()}')"}
